verdict.rationale: Archived docs described Smithery handling MCP connections for you through a REST interface (Connect). Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect and Toolbox stopped working on 2026-10-31, and that Smithery now remains only a public, non-proxied registry. No hosted endpoint is currently documented that a developer's MCP client can point at to reach downstream tools; listing third-party URLs in a registry is an adjacent capability, not Smithery hosting the connection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure
